entries.en: I'm here on Sha'ira's behalf. Your lies are hurting her.
Enjoy your drink, General.
What's bothering you, General?
I think I can see why you're upset, but spreading these lies won't make it better.
Is she really worth it? There must be other women.
Some general! What kind of example are you to your troops?
General, did you ever win a battle by moping in a bar?
Never let the enemy see your weakness. You know that, General.
You need to start acting like a general if you want to beat this.
You're a damn general. Quit your whining.
Now get up and get moving, General.
Sha'ira sent me.
Problems?
Straighten up.
Get a grip.
I'm not leaving.
Forget this.
There's an elcor diplomat out there who believes Sha'ira gave up his secrets.
Because I told him. Look, I just need you to convince him of the truth.
You'll bring him proof.
Well, the last time he saw me, I was disparaging his ancestors and shouting his secrets in public.
Take this datapad. It shows where I got my info. It will exonerate Sha'ira and convince the elcor.
His name is Xeltan. He's an elcor diplomat. He's over in the embassies complaining about Sha'ira.
You sure? It's a simple job; it won't take you long at all.
That's all right. I'll deal with it after I've spoken with Sha'ira.
Thanks, Commander. You know... you might make a good general yourself one day.
Hard to imagine a general like that getting so upset about a woman.
That's because you don't understand women, Kaidan.
Are you sure, Commander? I don't feel right just leaving him here.
Ha! Don't waste your time, kid. Run away now, while you still can.
Yeah, yeah. It's for the best.
Ha! You got balls, kid. There are only five people in this damn galaxy who'd talk to me like that.
What makes you think he'll believe me?
Why can't you tell him yourself?
Who am I taking it to and where is he?
I've already got a lot on my plate, General.
Sorry, General.
Goodbye, General.
You make me sick!
I'm done here.
It's not just any woman I want. It's her, and her alone.
Don't waste your time on me, kid.
Ah, it's too late for me.
Don't let that asari witch fool you, kid.
It damn well couldn't hurt.
This is pathetic. What could a woman do to put you in this state?
I don't think it could hurt.
It's better than sitting on your ass all day.
It would be more productive than sitting here.
Why would he believe such a thing?
And why is that?
Why does he think that?
I don't feel right just leaving like this.
I feel bad leaving him like this, Commander.
We can't just leave him like this.
Are we going to give up just like that?
This is the great turian general? How did your kind ever defeat us?
I may be drunk, krogan, but you're ugly. And tomorrow, I'll be sober. Now unless you have a cure for this ache in my gut, go away.
If you feel this way, General, then why spread lies about her?
Then why create rumors and lies about this woman?
I can help.
No. I'd rather not be remembered at all. But I see your point.
C'mon. It'll only take you a minute.
Well. Here's to soldiers acting like soldiers.
Keep your datapad. I don't have time for this.
Do you really want to be remembered this way?
You do it.
All right. I'll go to her... after I've had a cold shower. Or two.
This is no place for someone of your stature, General.
Finally.
(Whispers) If you've got questions about Jenna, meet me at C-Sec academy.
Push off! I never did nothing to you.
Damn newcomers. Think they can run the place.
What the hell was all that about?
What did you just say?
I guess we'd better go find out.
Jenna?
Follow him.
What was that about?
What the hell was that about?
That's Chellick. What's he up to?
That was odd. What was he trying to tell us?
Are you talking to me?
I'd like a lot of things, human. Desire forms the foundations of organized society.
That said, the xenophobe will remain in turian custody. This is not negotiable.
The xenophobe? I should have known he'd have friends.
Thank you for the information. We'll increase the guard on his cell.
I knew you'd rat us out, Shepard! Now it's payback time!
You've got a prisoner named Curt Weisman. I'd like that prisoner freed.
I'd rather not have to kill all your guards to free this man.
As a Spectre on an important mission, I'd like you to cut him loose.
A human named Finch wanted me to use my authority as a Spectre to free Curt Weisman.
Cut Curt Weisman loose.
I want a human released.
I've got a warning.
Make it negotiable.
I can find a dozen Reds who'll swear they saw you kill aliens for fun. Who's going to believe you then?
You never leave the life! If you won't help us, we'll drag your name through the dirt!
Your alien friends will revoke your Spectre status. You'll be nothing. Unless you're willing to pay, say, 500 credits.
The Spectre is right. This is humanity's chance to prove itself. There is even talk of earning a Council seat.
Of course you'd side with Shepard! You want someone who's in bed with your kind!
But this is your career! You'd throw it all away like that?
The Spectre has overcome a troubled youth to lead a proud military career. The turians would not care about such things.
And I doubt your lies would fool the salarians or the asari.
Fine, Shepard. You're right. You're not one of the Reds. Maybe you never were.
Impressive. Perhaps the first human Spectre will not be a disappointment after all.
Goodbye, Spectre.
Pleasure to see you again, Shepard. Feel free to drop by next time you're groundside.
That man is a xenophobe who thinks he can blackmail a Spectre. You should have killed him.
Goodbye, human. It will be interesting to see what kind of Spectre you turn out to be.
He attempted to poison medical cargo being sent to a turian colony to treat an outbreak of a dangerous disease.
If he had succeeded, millions would have died. This human is a dangerous xenophobe.
Considering that he attempted to commit a xenophobic hate crime, I would expect him to receive a lifetime imprisonment.
The human acknowledged his affiliation with several anti-alien organizations.
His crime specifically targeted turians as a species. It was a hate crime, and will be treated as such at his sentencing.
Why do you want this criminal released? Is it part of your mission, or are you just helping another human?
The Council should have known that humans were not ready for the authority of the Spectres.
The prisoner will be released. The turian people, at least, respect the rule of law.
Are you suggesting that you are using him as bait to entrap more powerful criminals?
In that case, I shall go now. The criminal will be released in a few hours.
Good luck with your mission. I look forward to hearing of the results.
I understand. Weisman was too well-supplied to be acting alone.
I knew you didn't have what it takes, Shepard. If you can't be useful, you'll be publicity.
When we're through telling our story, the aliens will all know what the first human Spectre really is.
What do I want? I want aliens off of Earth. I want the Council to stay out of humanity's business.
They don't know that the Reds target aliens specifically. We've got the backers to handle offworld missions.
Your alien friends won't like you so much when they hear what your gang did.
They're a human movement now. You think the vids will make that distinction?
What crime did Weisman commit?
What sentence is Weisman likely to receive?
Why are you calling him a xenophobe?
I'm a Spectre. I don't answer to you! Release Weisman. Now!
I'm not suggesting anything. I'm just making a polite request.
Trust me on this: letting Weisman go will solve a lot of problems in the long run.
Thanks for the information. One of Weisman's friends was less than honest with me.
Forget it. This isn't worth my time.
I seem to have been misinformed. I won't take up any more of your time.
What do you want, Finch? What gets you out of my life?
My bio is public record. Everyone knows that I ran with gangs as a kid.
The Tenth Street Reds was a gang, not an Earth-first movement.
No. They won't.
What is this going to prove? I left that life a long time ago!
If you want humanity to be strong, a smear attack on the first human Spectre is a bad idea.
I'm trying to make humanity strong, Finch! Are you going to stand in my way?
We need the other races, Finch. That's the best way to strengthen humanity.
You think I care what the aliens think of me, Finch?
The aliens need me, Finch. I'm not going anywhere, no matter what stories you tell.
I can legally execute everyone in this bar. You think the Council cares about my shady past?
What I'm doing is too important to be derailed by someone like you, Finch.
Fine. Get out of here. We're done.
